properties.name: Neszele
properties.sourceSchemaIdentityNotes: Neszele and Ságod have separately labeled observed map contours in shared chapter unit16. This is Neszele only, not an alias or clone of the grouped parent.
properties.sourcePeriod: 2025-08-30 ZIFFA consultation draft; adoption not independently established; backdrop date unknown
properties.method: Four-neighbor interior of largest eight-neighbor dark component, max(R,G,B)<120. Exact source-cell union; no buffers, snapping, closure bridges, clipping or geometric repair. Explicit estimated placement using four road-center junctions and a similarity transform in EOV, then inverse projection to WGS84.
reviewNotes: Observed native source interior is preserved exactly; source contour observation and world placement are separate claims.
Grouped chapter indicators do not merge Neszele and Ságod map identities. No group-parent polygon was copied into either child.
Source consultation study does not establish statutory, legal, cadastral or surveyed quarter boundaries.
Separate two-junction placement is retained as an alternative hypothesis, not another quarter or accuracy bound.
